findings.claim: Controller: explicit status saves; blank/omitted toggles. Human opening clears AI and agent self-assigns; AgentBot pending+explicit open invokes handoff without assigning @status. Template emits success, conversation_id, current_status, snoozed_until. EE controller adds no toggle override.

Proposed matrix: blank/omitted across all states; explicit pending/open/resolved/snoozed; epoch/absent snooze deadline, ignored deadline on blank status and exit reset; agent/admin AI+assignee effects; bot handoff versus blank toggle, waiting_since blank/present, event and response fields. Characterize handoff payload.success; no reproduced defect.
